findings.description:
Log (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_033.sol#81-105) contract sets array length with a user-controlled value:
	- History.push(LastMsg) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_033.sol#102)

Reentrancy in MONEY_BOX.Collect(uint256) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_033.sol#55-69):
	External calls:
	- msg.sender.call.value(_am)() (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_033.sol#63)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- acc.balance -= _am (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_033.sol#65)
	MONEY_BOX.Acc (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_033.sol#17) can be used in cross function reentrancies:
	- MONEY_BOX.Acc (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_033.sol#17)
	- MONEY_BOX.Collect(uint256) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_033.sol#55-69)
	- MONEY_BOX.Put(uint256) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_033.sol#45-53)

MONEY_BOX.Put(uint256) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_033.sol#45-53) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- now + _lockTime > acc.unlockTime (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_033.sol#51)

MONEY_BOX.Collect(uint256) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_033.sol#55-69) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- acc.balance >= MinSum && acc.balance >= _am && now > acc.unlockTime (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_033.sol#60)
